_doc: iter_019 v9b: v9 (TOD-augmented LGB models) + v2 original ensemble weights (w_lgb=1.5, beta_1=0.40). Isolates TOD feature contribution only, without T150 LOSO-tuned changes. Models identical to v9/v2 (T87 SPO+ NN + T75 LGB with TOD). Compliance: per-sym beta lookup only, not fed to model.

horizons._doc: v9b: TOD-augmented LGB models (from v9/T151b) + v2 original DE weights (w_lgb=1.5). Clean isolation: only TOD features added vs v2, no T150 LOSO threshold changes.

conformal_wrapper._doc: beta = 4-fold CV consensus / V8 in-sample fit from R_conformal_select (REPORT.md). sigma = std(combined_pred) per sym on local val 442k. OOD: beta = mean(per_sym_beta) = 0.16, sigma = mean(per_sym_sigma). beta_1=0.40 (v2 original, not T150's 0.50).
